A_through_flight_head.why: a DN32 path needs >= 792 mm2 (one 32 mm bore, or e.g. 6x 13 mm holes) from the pre-chamber through the head plug to a disc holder above it; the plug is 57.2 mm with the seat insert (20.2 counterbore) on the axis, the M5 row and 2 glands at r 22-28.6, and the r 10-21.5 annulus already carries the manifold bore, the E1-M filter/axial drillings, the Pc and torch passages and the 4 bonnet screws; any 792 mm2 of new holes there removes the injector features or the face-disc support: a different injector, not a flight-representative head

B_stand_case_section_window.hardware: TC-01S: stand-only 316L case (or 316L forward section) with the window at the pre-chamber station; saddle disc holder (oblong-to-round transition, DN32 disc) welded/bolted on the OD; TC-06S insulator with the same window; a sacrificial phenolic or graphite heat shield in front of the disc (ASSUMED necessity: the disc face otherwise sees the pre-chamber gas on every burn)
consequences: pre-chamber +19 cm3 (+32 %, window through the 3.175 mm wall + a 20 mm DN32 neck, ESTIMATE) and asymmetric (Combustion: the stand test then differs from flight in the head-end volume and mixing)
disc exposed to hot gas -> premature-burst / fragment risk unless shielded (shield adds delay and changes the relief area)
TC-06/TC-01 joint and insulation changed at the hottest metal station

C_spacer_ring.note: a 43 mm stand-only spacer with a radial DN32 port lengthens the pre-chamber 30 -> ~73 mm (Combustion change)

reaction.model: sonic orifice, F = C_F P0 A*, g 1.2 ASSUMED
reaction.servo_reference: SB-2292SG stall 2.16 N m (Electronics) through the TVC levers: the gimbal cannot react a lateral 3-6 kN at the head; the stand must lock the gimbal (rigid stand adapter) or the outlet must be a balanced tee

discharge_path: radial at the disc; on the stand: DN32 elbow on the holder turning the jet aft (or a balanced tee with two opposed outlets, net lateral load ~0) and ducted out of the test cell; never into a vehicle bay
recommendation: head-end DN32 not feasible on the flight head or as an adapter on it; possible only as a stand-only case section (B) or spacer (C) that changes the pre-chamber Combustion is testing.  Mechanical recommends the fallback: shorter stand windows with a rounded grain-port entrance (r >= 4 mm) and the aft TC-09S DN32 disc; reconsider B only if Combustion accepts the changed pre-chamber on the stand
